recent_posts.title: Simplify Your Kubernetes Migration with Cortex
recent_posts.summary: Migrating a Kubernetes cluster to Amazon EKS can enhance operational efficiency but presents challenges in reliability, compliance, and observability. Cortex Scorecards streamline this migration by offering structured benchmarks, continuous monitoring, and customizable standards for service health, security, and operational consistency. They provide real-time insights to ensure a smooth transition and optimize services for EKS-specific features.

recent_posts.title: Our ISO 27001 Certification
recent_posts.summary: Cortex, an enterprise Internal Developer Portal, has received ISO 27001 certification via Prescient Security. This certification demonstrates Cortex’s commitment to high standards of data protection and security best practices. ISO/IEC 27001 is an internationally recognized standard for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS), and it provides assurance to businesses and customers that Cortex adheres to rigorous security standards. This certification enhances Cortex’s reliability and trustworthiness as a secure engineering management platform.

recent_posts.title: Workflows General Availability
recent_posts.summary: Cortex Workflows has achieved General Availability, featuring advanced Role-Based Access Controls (RBAC) that allow granular control over who can view, edit, and run workflows. This enhances security and efficiency for enterprises handling sensitive operations. Cortex Workflows integrate seamlessly with existing tools, enabling automation of complex developer tasks while incorporating human inputs where necessary. New features include centralized task management, automated steps with conditional logic, robust access controls, and entity-based permissioning, all of which streamline operations and secure critical workflows.

recent_posts.title: IDPCon 2024 Recap
recent_posts.summary: IDPCon 2024 gathered over 300 attendees in New York City's Times Square for a one-day event hosted by Cortex, focusing on developer productivity, platform engineering, AI, and the build vs. buy dilemma for internal developer portals. Key trends included reevaluating productivity metrics using frameworks like SPACE, debates on custom-built versus ready-made IDPs, and advancing automation to enhance development efficiency. The event featured notable speakers and roundtable discussions aimed at sharing best practices and redefining engineering excellence.

recent_posts.title: Custom Metrics in Cortex
recent_posts.summary: Cortex's Eng Intelligence solution now includes Custom Metrics, enabling organizations to define and track their own unique performance measures. With over 50 pre-integrations and an API for custom data, users can create metrics tailored to their needs. The solution supports both out-of-the-box and customized metrics, offering insights into both output and input metrics. Whether using CQL for SQL-like operations or the API for programmatic metrics, Cortex allows flexible tracking and analysis to enhance team productivity and efficiency.

recent_posts.title: How Cortex Speeds Production Readiness
recent_posts.summary: Engineering teams face challenges in ensuring production readiness due to manual processes in tracking technical, security, and performance standards. Cortex automates this process with features like real-time dashboards, automated notifications, pre-approved templates, and reusable scorecards, significantly reducing time and manual effort. This streamlines product launches and ensures compliance, allowing developers to focus more on coding and less on administrative tasks.

recent_posts.title: AWS Partnership
recent_posts.summary: Cortex has joined the AWS ISV Accelerate Program, a co-sell initiative for software solutions integrating with AWS. This partnership aims to provide AWS customers with enhanced development tools, improving modernization, productivity, and compliance. Cortex is now available on AWS Marketplace, offering a unified platform for managing AWS and third-party resources. The post also announces Cortex's presence at AWS re:Invent 2024 and IDPCON in October.

recent_posts.title: ServiceNow Investment
recent_posts.summary: Cortex celebrates a significant milestone with ServiceNow investing in their Series C funding round. This partnership aims to unify tech operations at the enterprise level through Cortex’s Internal Developer Portal (IDP). The collaboration promises to bridge the gap between engineering and IT teams, enhancing productivity through smarter self-service workflows, automation, and proactive insights. This new investment is set to elevate the developer experience by providing frictionless onboarding, workflow automation, and real-time performance insights.

recent_posts.title: Exploring Key Discussions Shaping the Future of Platform Engineering
recent_posts.summary: Platform engineering is rapidly evolving, and teams are debating numerous topics such as the distinction from DevOps, the balance of abstraction, and the challenges of multi-cloud environments. Key debates include whether platform engineering is just DevOps 2.0, the right level of abstraction, handling multi-cloud complexities, and the use of Kubernetes. The discussions extend to the balance between security and developer autonomy, the centralization of platform engineering teams, and the implications of AI in platform operations.

recent_posts.title: Faster Incident Response
recent_posts.summary: Cortex helps streamline incident response by centralizing engineering data, including service ownership and response tool feeds. This integration allows easy identification of responsible parties, ready access to up-to-date runbooks, and real-time tracking of incidents, effectively reducing the time developers spend addressing issues and allowing them to focus more on building features and long-term stability.
